implemented: One native service-mode/keyspace-group discovery and PD/TSO protocol adapter consumed by native Cluster and TiDB.
GetClusterInfo rejects empty modes and header errors; only Unimplemented selects classic compatibility.
API mode resolves group primary through FindGroupByKeyspaceID, includes keyspace/group/callee headers, rejects stale revisions, and never falls back to the PD leader Tso endpoint.

Legacy default-primary lookup uses PD MetaStorage and serialized TSO Participant; nonzero assigned groups prohibit legacy fallback. This legacy path is implemented but not exercised against a live legacy cluster.

Native refresh preserves healthy equal routes, retires changed routes, retains interrupted retirement, and joins periodic discovery before streams on close. Valid metadata leader publication is independent of TSO discovery errors.
API-v2 metadata configures native keyspace routing before publishing the V2 client.

TiDB periodic discovery has an independent owned thread/runtime. Metadata bypasses its lock; timestamp discovery waits stay within the original deadline. Explicit shutdown cancels and joins discovery before acknowledgement.

Shared round-robin attempt selection survives failed/cancelled snapshots and initial Connection retries; failed group metadata remains unpublished. A stalled first endpoint no longer prevents reaching a healthy alternate.
